label: Whatever is in POTENCY_1 in no respect has a life that neither begins nor ends in the…, from change
description: Whatever is in potency in no respect has a life that neither begins nor ends: a life boundary between two times is a change in some respect between them (OPEN; denied by whoever holds that generation or creation is no change of the thing), and whatever changes in a respect is in potency in it (OPEN q.9 a.1 reading for potency in the subject); a pure act has no potency. The q.9 a.2 potency-in-another reading (DISAMB-POTENCY-IN-SUBJECT-VS-IN-ANOTHER) now sits in the second premise.
